name: Client Onboarding
description: Kickoff, internal handoff from sales, onboarding portal, and reverse-demo walkthrough of current processes. Added to every new-client SOW alongside the other workstream(s).

name: CRM & Marketing Hub Launch
description: Designs the data model, configures the CRM and Marketing Hub, migrates data, and stands up campaigns and lifecycle.
audience: New HubSpot implementations led by marketing, often migrating from another CRM or marketing platform

name: Marketing Hub Launch
description: Configures the portal, users, and permissions, sets up Marketing Hub, and brings in lists and subscription statuses, without the lifecycle and sales handoff work of a full CRM launch.
audience: Clients using HubSpot as their marketing platform while the CRM of record lives elsewhere (for example DealCloud or Salesforce)

name: Sales Hub Launch
description: Designs the data model, configures the CRM and Sales Hub, builds the pipeline and lead process, and gives reps the tools and reporting to work in HubSpot.
audience: New HubSpot implementations led by sales

name: HubSpot Optimization & RevOps Support
description: Starts with an assessment and a prioritized roadmap, then works through cleanup, structure, and improvements as planned modules, with Ongoing RevOps Support for unplanned requests. Sold as blocks of hours, a monthly retainer sized to the plan, or a flexible monthly retainer.
audience: Existing HubSpot portals that need cleanup, structure, improvements, or ongoing RevOps support

name: Lead Management & Attribution
description: Defines the lead process and lifecycle, automates routing, scoring, and handoffs, and builds source tracking and attribution reporting.
audience: Clients whose leads are falling through the cracks or who cannot see what marketing is producing

name: Quoting & CPQ
description: Reviews the current quoting process, then builds the product library, pricing rules, quote templates, and approvals in HubSpot.
audience: Clients quoting outside HubSpot or with complex pricing

name: Service Hub Launch
description: Sets up the portal foundation, help desk, tickets, routing, and SLAs, with optional knowledge base, customer onboarding, and customer health scoring.
audience: Clients bringing support or customer success into HubSpot

name: Marketing Platform Migration
description: Inventories the old platform and decides what moves, rebuilds the approved assets and automation in HubSpot, migrates records and subscription statuses, and sets up Marketing Hub to run on.
audience: Clients moving to HubSpot from another marketing platform (for example Marketo, Pardot, or Mailchimp)

name: Contract & Subscription Management
description: Covers the full contract lifecycle in HubSpot: products and pricing, quotes, subscription creation, mid-term amendments, renewals, and the pipelines that run them.
audience: Clients selling subscriptions or recurring contracts who need quoting, renewals, and mid-term changes in HubSpot

name: CRM Platform Migration
description: Designs the HubSpot data model, cleans and migrates data from the old CRM, configures the CRM, and cuts over and shuts down the old platform.
audience: Clients moving to HubSpot from another CRM or sales platform (for example Salesforce, Salesloft, or SuiteCRM)

name: AI & Automation
description: Confirms which processes are stable enough to automate, then adds AI agents, automated outreach and enrichment, self-service, and automation flows on top of a proven foundation.
audience: Clients with a working HubSpot foundation who want to scale it with AI agents and automation
